vqa.why: temperature fitted on held-out data and verified to improve ECE

counting.why: count head shares the VQA encoder family; not independently calibrated

cdvqa.why: no fitted temperature in the checkpoint; probabilities are the raw softmax

change.equation: thresholded change-probability map; F1 on LEVIR-CD val (thr=0.85)
change.why: no temperature applies: the confidence is a closed-form blend of change-map evidence, not a softmax over classes

grounding.why: high confidence from a low-reliability method is capped by trust, not by this label
